cards.front: Minute hand and hour hand
cards.back: The long minute hand shows minutes. The short hour hand shows hours.
cards.say: Minute hand and hour hand. The long minute hand shows minutes. The short hour hand shows hours.

cards.front: How many minutes are in an hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in an hour? Sixty minutes.

cards.front: How many minutes are in a quarter of an hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in a quarter of an hour? Fifteen minutes.

cards.front: How many minutes are in half an hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in half an hour? Thirty minutes.

cards.front: When the minute hand points to 3, how many minutes past?
cards.say: When the minute hand points to three, how many minutes past? Fifteen minutes past. Count in fives: five, ten, fifteen.

cards.front: When the minute hand points to 6, how many minutes past?
cards.back: 30 minutes past, so it is half past.
cards.say: When the minute hand points to six, how many minutes past? Thirty minutes past, so it is half past.

cards.front: When the minute hand points to 9, what do we say?
cards.back: Quarter to the next hour. It is 45 minutes past.
cards.say: When the minute hand points to nine, what do we say? Quarter to the next hour. It is forty-five minutes past.

cards.front: Quarter past 4 is the same as...
cards.say: Quarter past four is the same as four fifteen.

cards.front: Half past 7 is the same as...
cards.say: Half past seven is the same as seven thirty.

cards.front: Quarter to 9 is the same as...
cards.say: Quarter to nine is the same as eight forty-five.

cards.front: What time does the clock show?
cards.say: What time does the clock show? Quarter past three.

figure.alt: A clock showing quarter past three.

cards.front: Tell the time.
cards.say: Tell the time. Half past six.

figure.alt: A clock showing half past six.

cards.front: Read this clock.
cards.say: Read this clock. Quarter to five.

figure.alt: A clock showing quarter to five.

cards.front: What time is it?
cards.say: What time is it? Ten minutes past two.

figure.alt: A clock showing ten minutes past two.

cards.front: Which time is shown?
cards.say: Which time is shown? Twenty-five minutes past eight.

figure.alt: A clock showing twenty-five minutes past eight.

cards.front: Count in 5s round the clock face
cards.say: Count in fives round the clock face. Five, ten, fifteen, twenty, twenty-five, thirty, thirty-five, forty, forty-five, fifty, fifty-five, sixty.

cards.front: Minute hand on 4 means how many minutes past?
cards.say: Minute hand on four means how many minutes past? Twenty minutes past. Four times five equals twenty.

cards.front: Minute hand on 8 means how many minutes past?
cards.say: Minute hand on eight means how many minutes past? Forty minutes past. Eight times five equals forty.

cards.front: What is 20 minutes past 5 in digital time?
cards.say: What is twenty minutes past five in digital time? Five twenty.

cards.front: What is 7:45 in words?
cards.say: What is seven forty-five in words? Quarter to eight.

cards.front: What does a.m. mean?
cards.back: Times from midnight to noon: the morning.
cards.say: What does A M mean? Times from midnight to noon: the morning.

cards.front: What does p.m. mean?
cards.back: Times from noon to midnight: afternoon, evening and night.
cards.say: What does P M mean? Times from noon to midnight: afternoon, evening and night.

cards.front: How many hours are in a day?
cards.say: How many hours are in a day? Twenty-four hours.

cards.front: The hour hand is on 6 and the minute hand is on 12. What time?
cards.say: The hour hand is on six and the minute hand is on twelve. What time? Six o'clock.
